M2 Migration – User Guide

This guide is for the people who move the clients of M2 Mandat into Odoo with the M2 → CSP Migration tool. No technical knowledge is needed. Each step says what you see, what to do, and what comes next.

The pictures in this guide show no client data. They were taken from the tool's made-up sample data, with Hide client data switched on: names, values and messages appear as grey bars. Your screens show your real data.

1. What the tool does, in one minute

  • It reads what M2 exports. You export the client lists from M2 (mandates, addresses, officers, owners, bank details…) into one folder. The tool reads them as they are, German or English.
  • It prepares the files for Odoo. It writes CSP_Import_M2.xlsx, ready for Odoo's Client Import, and CSP_Import_M2_Review.xlsx with everything it left out and why.
  • You fill in what M2 does not know. For example which of our companies looks after a client, or which Odoo employee an M2 staff code stands for. The tool asks; it never guesses a company.
  • A local AI helps. The AI assistant runs on this computer (Ollama). It proposes answers and sorts the documents; you accept or not. Client data never goes to the cloud.
  • Nothing is written to Odoo by the tool. You load the prepared file in Odoo yourself, after checking it.
  • Every client keeps its own trail. For each M2 client the tool records every step it took: what it read, what it changed, why it loaded the client or left it out.

2. The path from M2 to Odoo

#StepWhere in the tool
1Export the lists from M2In M2 (your M2 contact does this), into one folder
2Run the migrationTop bar: Browse… to the folder, then Run migration
3Read the resultOverview: the summary and the Next steps list
4Fill in the missing detailsNeeds decision, then Run again
5Let the AI helpAI assistant: suggestions, document types, the sorting list
6Check clients one by oneRecords (each client's trail) and Review rows
7Load into OdooOdoo: Contacts › Configuration › Client Import (Check, then Import)

Steps 4 to 6 can be repeated as often as needed: a run takes seconds and always gives the same result for the same exports and answers.

3. Export from M2 and run

Put every list exported from M2 in one folder: Excel or CSV, as M2 gives them. Keep the column titles. The tool works out by itself which list is which (mandates, addresses, officers…), and says so in Files & columns.

  1. In the top bar press Browse… and choose the folder.
  2. Press Run migration. The run takes a few seconds; the bar under the top bar shows its stages.
  3. When it says done, the Overview shows the result.
Sample data (top bar) loads made-up exports to try the tool safely.

4. Overview: the result and what to do next

The Overview answers three questions: how many clients are ready, how many wait for you, and what to do next.

  • The summary line, e.g. 23 row(s) ready, 8 wait in review, with a button to the next place to look.
  • Next steps is your checklist. Each line says what is still needed and has a button that goes there. A tick means done. Lines marked (optional) add data but do not block the import.
  • The boxes count what happened: rows to import, rows to review, errors, warnings, values changed, values not loaded. Click one to see those items.

5. Needs decision: fill in the missing details

M2 does not know everything Odoo needs. This page lists each question once, with the clients it concerns. Answer, press Save, and when you are done press Run again. Your answers are kept and used on every later run.

SectionWhat you answer
Operating company of a mandate holderWhich of our companies looks after the clients of an M2 mandate holder. The tool never picks a default company: until you answer, those clients wait.
EmployeesWhich Odoo employee an M2 staff code (e.g. FF) stands for. Until then, Client Advisor and Deputy stay empty; the clients still load.
Type codesWhich register an M2 role code fills (directors, owners, shareholders…).
Files not recognisedWhat an export file is, when the tool could not tell.
Columns with no CSP fieldWhether an M2 column should go into an Odoo field. Each column shows what it means (e.g. MWSTPFLICHT = VAT liable), where it is in the file, and a suggested field with Use. Type in the Load into box to search the Odoo fields by name. Nothing is lost if you skip it: the values stay in the client's Notes.
Clients not found, other checksItems to fix in M2 or in the review file, then run again.
The AI's suggestion appears next to a question with a percentage (how sure it is) and Accept. Accept saves it like your own answer; you can take any answer back with the arrow next to it.

6. AI assistant: help from a local model

The AI assistant runs on this computer with Ollama. It reads the finished run and proposes: answers for Needs decision, the type of each document, where each document goes in the client's Odoo folders, and a short summary of the run. It never changes anything by itself.

  • Run all does everything; or press one task: Suggest decisions, Classify documents, Summary. A bar shows the progress in percent. Stop stops it; Resume goes on where it stopped.
  • Document types and folders: each file of the M2 archive gets a type (passport, register extract, invoice…) and the Odoo folder it goes to (Corporate Documents, Bank Statements, Correspondence…).
  • Sorting list: files the rules cannot place are listed in an Excel file, one row per M2 folder or name pattern. Choose the Odoo folder from the list, save, press Apply my sorting list: the tool remembers it for every later run.
  • Document packages: the files to upload into Odoo's Documents, in zip files, emails excepted.
Privacy. Client names, values, file names and documents stay on this computer. A company setting can allow only column titles and M2 codes to go to Claude (Anthropic's AI) for harder questions; it is off unless your company switches it on.

7. Data flow: the whole picture

The Data flow shows where the data comes from and where it goes, with the numbers of the current run: the M2 servers and the archive, the exports, this tool and the local AI, the two files it writes, and Odoo (staging, then production).

Below the diagram: what came out of M2 (per export), the documents per mandate holder, and the rows per Odoo sheet.

8. Records: each client's own trail

Every M2 client has a trail: every step the tool took for it, in order. Pick a client on the left (or type its M2 number or name): on the right you see what was read, how the client was found, what was changed and why it was loaded or left out, and the row that goes to Odoo.

  • The coloured labels show the level of each step: decision, change, not loaded, review, error.
  • Click a step for its details. Link copies an address that opens this client's trail directly: handy to show a colleague.

9. Journal: everything in order

The Journal lists every step of the run for all clients, as it happened. Use the buttons at the top to see only errors, reviews or changes, and the search box to find a client, a column or a value.

10. Review rows, changes and files

Review rows

The rows the tool could not load as they are. Each says why and how to fix it: in M2 (then export again) or directly in the review file, then load that row with the import file.

Changes & not loaded

Every value the tool converted or cleaned on the way (a date, a country, a phone number), and every M2 value that has no place in Odoo. Nothing disappears silently: what is not loaded is listed here and kept in the client's Notes.

Files & columns

How each export was read: which kind of list, which column went to which field, and which columns were not used.

Finance

Fees and open invoices from M2, per company and currency, to reconcile with Odoo after the import.

11. Load into Odoo

  1. On the Overview, download CSP_Import_M2.xlsx (or press Import file in Next steps).
  2. In Odoo open Contacts › Configuration › Client Import, upload the file and press Check. Check writes nothing: it lists what would be created or updated, and any problem.
  3. When the check is clean, press Import. An import can be undone from the same screen.
  4. Then the documents: Documents › Configuration › M2 Document Packages, one entry per zip file, Import. Each file goes into its client's folder; the document type is set by a person when the file is checked.
The companies must exist in Odoo with their CSP Short Code (the M2 holder code, on the company's CSP tab): the import finds the operating company by it. Load in the test database first, then in production.

12. Settings and Hide client data

Everything you answered in Needs decision is kept here and can be changed. The eye button at the bottom of the side bar switches Hide client data on and off: names, values and messages turn into grey bars, while titles, buttons and counts stay. Use it when you share your screen, take screenshots or train colleagues.

13. Help and words used

The Docs tab has this guide and the detailed ones (rules, AI assistant, archive inventory). Each can be printed as PDF.

WordMeaning
M2 key / M2 numberThe client's number in M2, e.g. KP-00031-ENT. It identifies the client in Odoo too.
Mandate holderThe M2 database / office a mandate belongs to (e.g. ARVIS-PH). Each is one of our operating companies.
Operating companyOur company in Odoo that looks after the client.
CSP Short CodeThe company's short code in Odoo (the M2 holder code), used to find it on import.
RunOne pass of the tool over the exports. Each run is kept with its files and journal.
DecisionAn answer the tool needs from you, or a choice the tool made by its rules (both are in the trail).
Review rowA row that could not be loaded as it is, with the reason and the fix.
Not loadedAn M2 value with no place in Odoo: listed in the review file and kept in the client's Notes.
OllamaThe program that runs the AI model on this computer.
